title: gtk: fix mouse cursor shape when selecting text
body:
Fixes #14380 where the mouse cursor shape reverts to the default when selecting text.

Set the mouse cursor shape on the `RenderSurface` widget instead of on `Surface`. To find the cursor shape to show, GTK starts at the widget under the mouse and walks up the tree to find an ancestor that has a cursor shape set. But when pointer grab is active, GTK will stop looking at the widget the grab started at. When selecting text, the widget under the mouse is `RenderSurface` and pointer grab is active so that lookup stops there and the shape set on `Surface` is ignored.

Manually tested that everything cursor-related still works: hiding the cursor with the `mouse-hide-while-typing` option, setting mouse shape with OSC22 and other widgets like the search UI still set their own shape.

AI Disclosure: Changes and PR written by myself, used AI in researching GTK's mouse cursor logic.
